spellbook.finance/limitations: Demand behavior, actors and internal tuning are omitted from every amendment projection.
This is saved configuration evidence. It does not prove any listing changed.
Workspace membership and seller entitlement remain backend-enforced.

description: List bounded seller pricing amendments with selector, marketplace scope, absolute multiplier, protected band, enabled state, priority and timestamps. It returns a cursor plus missing evidence and limitations.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a prior list response. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Maximum amendments to return, 1 to 100. Omit for 50.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the seller selected. The caller must own it. Required.

name: spellbook_pricing_amendments_list
